_about: Snap (camera) mode data (docs/modes/snap-design.md, deep dive D1-D9 and the build brief s12). Phases 0-1: the still orchard, the viewfinder, prints and Show Nani, G1 Just so many, G2 The big one, G3 Show Nani, G4 Ali's camera (greybox). No Kutchi is invented here: every word a row carries is borrowed from data/content.json (fruit, numbers) or data/cook.json (vadho, nindho, nar, the frames), and new lines are English placeholders with "kutchi": null. Levels are data: each mini-game's `levels` list gives level 1 in full and later levels only what changes (as in Cook).

words._about: Merged into the shared word table (Cook.data.words) when snap.html loads, as Find it does. The pool is the orchard's fruit (D8 priority 1). Numbers 1-5 and ph-big/ph-small/ph-no are already in data/cook.json.

lines._about: New lines Snap needs (D8 priority 5 and 8). None has Kutchi yet: each shows as a grey English placeholder until the family gives it. Keys are prefixed snap- so they never collide with Cook's.

kinds._about: The kinds of shot (D1). K1-K3 are built; K4-K6 need the moving world or rel.js (phase 4).

K1.name: The count shot
K1.rule: exactly n of the noun at least countVisible showing; other nouns don't matter

K2.name: The pick shot
K2.rule: the named one is the main subject (mechanics.photo.mainSubject), and of that size

K3.name: The leave-out shot
K3.rule: K1 or K2, and every {y} under excludeMax showing

viewfinder._about: js/snap/mechanics/viewfinder.js. `base`: the frame at zoom 1, in world units, always in the middle of the stage. `zooms`: the zoom steps (+/-). `drag`: pan by dragging (level 2+). `aimAssist`: tap-to-centre snaps to a tapped fruit's centre (1 = always; below 1 the centre moves that share of the way). `hesitateMs`: no shot for this long and Nani says the list again (free the first time). `quietMs`: the quiet after the intro card.

photo._about: js/snap/photo.js. Film is rows + filmSpare. The main-subject rule (K2) and the count rule (K1) and the leave-out rule (K3), all rated on the print record. The lens star is rated on the biggest thing in frame, never the wanted one. Lens numbers are tuned for still fruit (design s7 had 15-70% and the middle third for one animal): the biggest fruit at least 8% of the frame, its centre in the middle half, at least 90% showing, so a count shot of two or three can earn it when zoomed in.

handin._about: js/snap/mechanics/handin.js: Show Nani. Rows asked again in a new order; a wrong print gets a recast from its print record, then you choose again; none fits: back for goBackFrames more frames, at most maxGoBacks times a row (then Nani says 'Nearly!' and moves on, so a round always ends). The ear star needs minTested rows at word stage 2+ (js/snap/stubs/stars.js until the shared star sets arrive).

ali-camera._about: js/snap/mechanics/ali-camera.js (G4). The child says the picture card; Ali frames what he heard. timeoutMs for listen(); lowConfidence below which a result counts as unsure; two unsure results or a null bring up the pills; waitMs before Ali asks 'Which one?' again, once.

games._about: The mini-games (D2) and their level ladders (D5). A level lists only what changes from level 1. rows: how many rows (or [min, max]). kinds: how many fruit kinds hang in the orchard. perKind: fruit of each kind (count scenes). clustersPerKind: size clusters per kind (size scenes). counts: the numbers asked (uniform over those achievable). sizes: 'mid' (all one size) or 'three' (big, mid, small; mid is never asked). interleave: count clusters mix two kinds. photobomber: a bunch of another kind beside every cluster. notChance: the share of rows with a leave-out ('nar {y}'). sceneWidth: screens.

g1.name: Just so many
g1.goal: Frame exactly what Nani says: how many, and of what. Nothing tells you if a photo is right until you show Nani.

g2.name: The big one
g2.goal: Frame the one Nani means so it fills the middle of the photo: the big one or the small one.

g4.name: Ali's camera
g4.goal: Ali has the camera. Look at the card and SAY what to shoot: Ali takes the photo of what he hears. Then show Nani.
g4._levels: Lab levels 1 and 2 are the design's levels 2 and 3 (Ali's rows start at level 2). Rows alternate (D4): the 1st and 3rd are the child's own shots, as in G1; the 2nd and 4th are Ali's, from a picture card the child says. All are handed in to Nani; Ali's rows never touch the ear star (his mistakes are his), and they earn the voice star. Level 1: the card shows a count of one fruit and the child says the fruit (the count is Ali's, not tested). Level 2: two listens, the number, then the fruit.

star_set._about: Snap's stars (design s7). The icon names are js/cook/ui.js ICON names; 'lens' is added by js/snap/stubs/stars.js until the shared star sets arrive.

ear.name: Understood
ear.tip: Understood: every photo Nani asked for, picked right first time

hand.name: Good shot
hand.tip: Good shot: the main thing big, whole and in the middle of every photo you handed in

relaxed.name: No help
relaxed.tip: No help: no second replays, reveals or translations

busy.name: Quick
busy.tip: Quick: done before the daylight ran out

voice.name: Said it
voice.tip: Said it: Ali understood every card you said (or a grown-up ticked it)

help._about: Help costs (design 6.3), as Find it: the first replay is free, then the no-help star. Reveal and translate cost the ear star for that row too.

ear.wrong: Listen to Nani's row again (the speaker) before you shoot, and again before you pick a photo.
ear.count: Count what's in the frame before you press the shutter: exactly that many.
ear.no: One row says what NOT to have in the photo. Keep that fruit out of the frame.
ear.pick: Make the one Nani means big and in the middle, with no other one of it beside it.
ear.shown: Try without the eye or the English next time.

hand.default: Zoom in so the main fruit is big, whole, and in the middle of the frame.

third.relaxed: Try it with no hints: listen, then shoot.
third.busy: Be quicker: the daylight bar shows how long you have.

voice.default: Say the word on Ali's card out loud; the pills are there if he can't hear you.

leakbot._about: build/leak_snap.mjs: rounds per strategy per level, and the gates (design 8.4, build brief phase 0).
